purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: AI-Enabled Turbine Asset Management and U.S. Power Buildout
question: What technology is actually being used to manage turbine assets as the United States expands power infrastructure, how much is genuinely automated with AI, and how fast are the physical and digital buildouts moving?
bluf: Turbine management is a stack of sensors, deterministic controls, edge infrastructure, remote monitoring, analytics and digital twins, and EAM/CMMS systems. Bounded AI inspection, anomaly detection and workflow automation operate now, while whole-plant autonomous O&M remains exceptional and most newly ordered large gas turbines will not operate until 2027 or later.
use_note: Evidence through August 9 supports bounded AI inspection, anomaly and workflow uses plus named buildout clocks. It does not establish whole-plant autonomous O&M, safety approval from capability claims, COD from an order or present operation of 2027-plus capacity.
